name: Arc & Tower
summary: A broad semicircular prayer hall meets one straight square minaret, giving the mosque a low, asymmetric profile.
why: The round hall is centered at x=49 and shares its y=73 foundation with the minaret. The tower overlaps the dome at x=69 without a seam, while the cap joins the shaft at y=39. A round doorway repeats the dome geometry as a generous negative opening.
risk: The dome is intentionally simplified to a semicircle. The square minaret provides the most specific mosque cue at small sizes.
sub2: One generous doorway under the dome
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque reduced to a memorable contrast of round and square forms.
